subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Absent Boss
description: A quick win: understand The Absent Boss.

hook.text: She had not had a one-on-one in three months. Decisions stalled. Approvals vanished into a silent inbox.

buildup.text: Absent bosses are often overloaded, not uncaring. They spread too thin and your team falls through the cracks.

discovery.text: The solution is self-management with strategic escalation. Do what you can, then escalate only decision-critical items.

twist.text: An absent boss can be an opportunity. You gain autonomy, make decisions, and build a track record of initiative.

climax.text: Set your own priorities, document decisions, and send a summary weekly. If they don't reply, proceed and note that.

punchline.text: Fill the vacuum with initiative. Document everything.

quiz.question: How can an absent boss be an opportunity?
options: You can slack off without consequences
You gain autonomy and build a track record of initiative
You can take over their responsibilities permanently
